description: Domain-agnostic codebase conventions & shared pattern registry (Backend, Frontend, Mobile, CLI, Database) enforced by loop-guard.ts

loop_processes.guidance: Use scripts/loop/process.ts processRun for bounded POSIX process-group execution and scripts/loop/deadlines.ts for role budgets; preserve checkpoints and never terminate processes by worktree or name.

forge_discovery.guidance: Use SystemForgeAdapter paginated listIssues and getIssueStates batches; resolve only referenced dependencies and keep cached discovery separate from fresh target binding.

pattern_registry.contracts: Define shared schemas, DTOs, and domain types in dedicated contract/type modules with zero explicit 'any'.

ci_gate_evaluation.guidance: Evaluate upstream CI job outcomes in evaluateCiGateOutcome, failing closed on failure, cancelled, missing, or unauthorized skipped results.

pattern_registry.persistence: Execute database and external storage operations through repository/service abstractions and transactional migration helpers.

release_engineering.guidance: Stage POSIX install.sh with fail-closed SHA-256 verification into dist/releases/install.sh, generate Homebrew Formula labq-factory.rb via generateHomebrewFormula with fail-closed 64-hex SHA-256 validation, bundle standalone JS CLI via buildBundledCliScript, package extractable .tar.gz archives via packageCliDistributionTarball, compute deterministic SHA-256 digests in checksums.txt, verify binaries and bundled scripts with verifyCliBinarySmoke, and enforce unprivileged build / write-privileged publication separation in release.yml.

pattern_registry.error_handling: Return typed domain errors and structured status codes rather than silent catch blocks or raw exception strings.
pattern_registry.ui_primitives: Reuse canonical shared UI primitives (e.g. DataTable/SimpleTable, FormField/form hooks) when building frontend or mobile views.

workspace_governance.guidance: Enforce workspace package.json dependency boundaries and required open-source governance files using checkWorkspacePackageEdges and checkOpenSourceGovernanceFiles.
